verdict.rationale: Railway is a cloud provider, so auto-growing storage billed by bytes actually written is a fair question for it. The evidence pack never documents volume auto-growth or usage-based storage billing. The cloud-agent persistent-disk and sleep-billing items cover compute billing for agent machines, and the hard-spending-limits item is a different control, so neither supports this story.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I know attached disk/storage auto-grows with usage and I'm billed only for bytes actually written rather than pre-provisioned capacity
